Negatives: no component-missing empty state (0 hits); Approvals entry present for non-admin, setup absent — both hold.

## 3. #32955 HOLDS
- Approver (non-admin, pending): GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_approval_request 200, sys_approval_action 200 (27 / 22 fields, same set as admin); both listed in GET /api/v1/meta/object (52 objects). Console request page: 0 "Object Not Found", 0 "definition missing", Approve/Reject rendered on all of: inbox row click, cold ?request= deep link, direct URL under com.objectstack.account, alias account, and com.example.showcase (req A and req S); invoice record page approval panel shows Approve/Reject/Reassign/Send back/Request info. One decision executed through the request page and confirmed server-side.
- Submitter (RT submitter, not an approver): meta 200 both; deep link + direct URLs (3 segments) open req S page, only Recall offered (no Approve/Reject).
- Rows still refused: approver GET /api/v1/data/sys_approval_request/ID 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, list 403, /data/sys_approval_action 403 (also with filters, and POST /data/sys_approval_request/ID/page 403); same for submitter.
- sys_approval_approver: approver/submitter 404, not in list.
- Party to no request: RT nobody (no positions) and RT nobody2 (contributor+finance, bound after launches) → 404 on both meta reads (and on /meta/objects/ alias), neither object in /meta/object list (47 / 50 objects), /approvals/requests/:id 404, data 403; console shows "Object Not Found" with no request data.
- Admin control: meta 200 for all three, data rows 200 (5 requests / 5 actions), request page renders Approve/Reject/Reassign/Send back/Recall under all three segments and via deep link.
- Field-security masking: not exercised — no field-level restriction differs between admin and approver on these two objects in this fixture (identical field sets), so masking could not be observed either way.

## 4. Fails
None.

## 5. Off-clause probes (~3 min, approver + nobody, same boot)
Boundary/alias reads on the widened door: /meta/object/SYS_APPROVAL_REQUEST 404, trailing-space name 404, /meta/object/ 404, plural alias /meta/objects/sys_approval_request 200 for approver / 404 for nobody (consistent with singular); /approvals/requests/‹zero uuid› 404, /approvals/requests/%20 404; data filters and /page door 403 for both. Nothing found. Not covered: a past-actor-only persona (member is also submitter of A, so past-actor admission is not isolated) and the override-admin-without-admin-role case.

## 6. Checklist-accuracy notes
- acceptance[4] (and [3]'s "/apps/APP/"): the deep link and the row click land under the app that hosts the record's object (com.example.showcase), not the ‹appId› of the component route — deliberate since objectstack#32667 (ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx requestPagePath / objectHostAppSegment). The clause's "/apps/‹appId›/sys_approval_request/record/‹id›" should say "the record's host app segment".
- acceptance[6]: the language option is labelled "简体中文", not "中文（中国）"; the Language row in the avatar menu is a globe button opening a submenu (English / 简体中文).
- setup note: GET /api/v1/approvals/requests rejects `scope=` with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (supported: approverId, submitterId, status, …) — prior scripts used scope=mine.

## 7. Security findings
None.
